step1_figure.description: A two-input static CMOS NAND gate consisting of two parallel PMOS transistors (XMP1, XMP2) connected between VDD and the output Y, and two series NMOS transistors (XMN1, XMN2) connected between Y and GND. Input B is biased at VDD (1.8V), configuring the circuit as an inverter driven by input A.

switching_threshold.description: DC switching threshold voltage (VSP) where input voltage equals output voltage (Vin = Vout)

equation.formula: VSP = (Vthn + sqrt((KPp * Wp / Lp) / (KPn * Wn / (2 * Ln))) * (VDD - |Vthp|)) / (1 + sqrt((KPp * Wp / Lp) / (KPn * Wn / (2 * Ln))))
equation.explanation: Derived by equating saturated NMOS series pull-down current to saturated PMOS pull-up current when input B is tied to VDD.
equation.assumptions: Long-channel quadratic model; NMOS pull-down stack modelled as equivalent channel length 2*Ln; Wp=2um, Wn=1um, Lp=Ln=0.15um.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Slightly below mid-rail (0.9V) because the PMOS is sized at 2x NMOS width while effective NMOS beta is 270/2 = 135 uA/V^2, making the pull-down slightly stronger than pull-up.

propagation_delay_hl.description: High-to-low propagation delay (tPHL) measured from 50% Vin rise to 50% Vout fall

equation.explanation: Discharge time of load capacitance CL through the two series NMOS transistors.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Series NMOS transistors double the effective pull-down on-resistance relative to a single transistor.

propagation_delay_lh.description: Low-to-high propagation delay (tPLH) measured from 50% Vin fall to 50% Vout rise

equation.explanation: Charging time of load capacitance CL through single active PMOS XMP1.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Single PMOS pull-up device charges the 10 fF load capacitance.

fall_time.description: Output fall time (tf) from 90% (1.62V) to 10% (0.18V) of VDD

equation.explanation: 10-to-90% transition time discharging through series NMOS pair.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard RC transition time for 10%-90% logic swing.

rise_time.description: Output rise time (tr) from 10% (0.18V) to 90% (1.62V) of VDD

equation.explanation: 10-to-90% transition time charging through single PMOS.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Charging 10 fF output load via single PMOS on-resistance.

static_power.description: Static power consumption when input A is held at 0V or 1.8V

equation.explanation: Quiescent power consumed due to subthreshold and junction leakage currents.
equation.assumptions: Ileak approx 10 pA to 1 nA in typical 130nm process at room temperature.

sky130_expected.reasoning: MOSFET subthreshold leakage dominated in static steady state.

noise_margin_low.description: Low noise margin NML = VIL - VOL

equation.explanation: Difference between maximum input low voltage where slope is -1 and output low level (VOL=0V).

sky130_expected.calculation: VIL approx 0.68 V, VOL = 0 V -> NML = 0.68 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard static CMOS inverter-like noise margin with rail-to-rail swing.

noise_margin_high.description: High noise margin NMH = VOH - VIH

equation.explanation: Difference between output high level (VOH=VDD) and minimum input high voltage where slope is -1.

sky130_expected.calculation: VIH approx 1.05 V, VOH = 1.8 V -> NMH = 1.8 - 1.05 = 0.75 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard static CMOS logic with robust high noise immunity.

step3_testbench.description: DC and Transient simulation of Sky130 2-input NAND gate measuring switching threshold, propagation delays (tPLH, tPHL), transition times (tr, tf), and static power.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Sky130 2-Input NAND Gate Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt
.global VDD GND
.temp 27

.param L_XMP1=0.15u W_XMP1=2.0u
.param L_XMP2=0.15u W_XMP2=2.0u
.param L_XMN1=0.15u W_XMN1=1.0u
.param L_XMN2=0.15u W_XMN2=1.0u

* DUT
XMP1 Y A VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_XMP1} w={W_XMP1}
XMP2 Y B VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_XMP2} w={W_XMP2}
XMN1 Y A N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_XMN1} w={W_XMN1}
XMN2 N1 B GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_XMN2} w={W_XMN2}

* Load
CL Y GND 10e-15

* Supply and Input stimuli
VDD VDD GND DC 1.8
VB  B   GND DC 1.8
VA  A   GND DC 0 PULSE(0 1.8 1n 20p 20p 2n 4n)

.control
* 1. DC Operating Point & Static Power
op
let p_stat = -i(vdd) * 1.8
print p_stat

* 2. DC Sweep for Switching Threshold
dc VA 0 1.8 0.005
meas dc switching_threshold when v(Y)=v(A) cross=1

* 3. Transient Analysis for Delays and Transition Times
tran 1p 5n
* Propagation Delays (50% to 50%)
meas tran propagation_delay_hl trig v(A) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(Y) val=0.9 fall=1
meas tran propagation_delay_lh trig v(A) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(Y) val=0.9 rise=1

* Output Transition Times (10% to 90%)
meas tran fall_time trig v(Y) val=1.62 fall=1 targ v(Y) val=0.18 fall=1
meas tran rise_time trig v(Y) val=0.18 rise=1 targ v(Y) val=1.62 rise=1

print switching_threshold propagation_delay_hl propagation_delay_lh fall_time rise_time
quit
.endc
.end
